runs.final_sql: SELECT COUNT(acct.accn_id) FROM acct JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id WHERE acct.frqn = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' AND dstr.a3 = 'east Bohemia'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM acct AS a JOIN dstr AS d ON a.ref1 = d.dstr_id JOIN ln AS l ON l.ref1 = a.accn_id WHERE d.a3 = 'Prague'
SELECT CASE WHEN AVG(a12) > AVG(a13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END AS higher_year FROM dstr
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.dstr_id) FROM dstr d JOIN clnt c ON c.ref1 = d.dstr_id WHERE c.gndr = 'F' AND d.a11 > 6000 AND d.a11 < 10000
SELECT COUNT(clnt.clnt_id) FROM clnt JOIN dstr ON clnt.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id WHERE clnt.gndr = 'M' AND dstr.a3 = 'north Bohemia' AND dstr.a11 > 8000

SELECT DISTINCT a.accn_id, (SELECT MAX(a11) FROM dstr) - (SELECT MIN(a11) FROM dstr) AS gap
FROM clnt c
JOIN dsp d ON c.clnt_id = d.ref1
JOIN acct a ON d.ref2 = a.accn_id
JOIN dstr ds ON a.ref1 = ds.dstr_id
WHERE c.gndr = 'F'
  AND c.brth_dt = (SELECT MIN(c2.brth_dt) FROM clnt c2 WHERE c2.gndr = 'F')
  AND ds.a11 = (SELECT MIN(a11) FROM dstr)

SELECT a.accn_id
FROM clnt c
JOIN dsp d ON d.ref1 = c.clnt_id
JOIN acct a ON a.accn_id = d.ref2
JOIN dstr ds ON ds.dstr_id = c.ref1
ORDER BY c.brth_dt DESC, ds.a11 DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT clnt.clnt_id) FROM clnt JOIN dsp ON clnt.clnt_id = dsp.ref1 JOIN acct ON dsp.ref2 = acct.accn_id WHERE acct.frqn = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' AND dsp.typ = 'OWNER'

SELECT DISTINCT clnt.clnt_id
FROM clnt
JOIN dsp ON clnt.clnt_id = dsp.ref1
JOIN acct ON dsp.ref2 = acct.accn_id
WHERE acct.frqn = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
AND dsp.typ = 'DISPONENT'

SELECT a.accn_id
FROM acct a
JOIN ln l ON a.accn_id = l.ref1
WHERE YEAR(l.dt) = 1997
  AND a.frqn = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
ORDER BY l.amnt ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT acct.accn_id
FROM acct
JOIN ln ON acct.accn_id = ln.ref1
WHERE ln.drtn > 12
  AND YEAR(acct.dt) = 1993
ORDER BY ln.amnt DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(clnt.clnt_id) FROM clnt JOIN dstr ON clnt.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id WHERE clnt.gndr = 'F' AND clnt.brth_dt < '1950-01-01' AND dstr.a2 = 'Sokolov' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dsp WHERE dsp.ref1 = clnt.clnt_id)

SELECT DISTINCT t.ref1 AS accn_id
FROM trns t
WHERE YEAR(t.dt) = 1995
  AND t.dt = (
    SELECT MIN(t2.dt)
    FROM trns t2
    WHERE YEAR(t2.dt) = 1995
  )
SELECT DISTINCT acct.accn_id FROM acct JOIN trns ON acct.accn_id = trns.ref1 WHERE acct.dt < '1997-01-01' AND trns.blnc > 3000

SELECT DISTINCT clnt.clnt_id
FROM crd
JOIN dsp ON crd.ref1 = dsp.dsp_id
JOIN clnt ON dsp.ref1 = clnt.clnt_id
WHERE crd.issd = '1994-03-03'
SELECT acct.dt FROM trns JOIN acct ON trns.ref1 = acct.accn_id WHERE trns.amnt = 840 AND trns.dt = '1998-10-14'

SELECT dstr.dstr_id
FROM ln
JOIN acct ON ln.ref1 = acct.accn_id
JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id
WHERE ln.dt = '1994-08-25'

SELECT MAX(t.amnt)
FROM crd c
JOIN dsp d ON c.ref1 = d.dsp_id
JOIN trns t ON t.ref1 = d.ref2
WHERE c.issd = '1996-10-21'

SELECT c.gndr
FROM clnt c
JOIN dsp d ON c.clnt_id = d.ref1
JOIN acct a ON d.ref2 = a.accn_id
JOIN dstr ds ON a.ref1 = ds.dstr_id
WHERE d.typ = 'OWNER'
  AND ds.a11 = (SELECT MAX(a11) FROM dstr)
ORDER BY c.brth_dt ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT t.amnt
FROM ln l
JOIN trns t ON t.ref1 = l.ref1
ORDER BY l.amnt DESC, t.dt ASC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(clnt.clnt_id) FROM clnt JOIN dsp ON clnt.clnt_id = dsp.ref1 JOIN acct ON dsp.ref2 = acct.accn_id JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id WHERE dstr.a2 = 'Jesenik' AND clnt.gndr = 'F'
SELECT dsp.dsp_id FROM trns JOIN acct ON trns.ref1 = acct.accn_id JOIN dsp ON dsp.ref2 = acct.accn_id WHERE trns.dt = '1998-09-02' AND trns.amnt = 5100
SELECT COUNT(a.accn_id) FROM acct a JOIN dstr d ON a.ref1 = d.dstr_id WHERE d.a2 = 'Litomerice' AND YEAR(a.dt) = 1996

SELECT DISTINCT d.a2
FROM clnt c
JOIN dsp p ON p.ref1 = c.clnt_id
JOIN acct a ON a.accn_id = p.ref2
JOIN dstr d ON d.dstr_id = a.ref1
WHERE c.gndr = 'F' AND c.brth_dt = '1976-01-29'

SELECT clnt.brth_dt FROM ln JOIN acct ON ln.ref1 = acct.accn_id JOIN dsp ON dsp.ref2 = acct.accn_id JOIN clnt ON dsp.ref1 = clnt.clnt_id WHERE ln.amnt = 98832 AND ln.dt = '1996-01-03' AND dsp.typ = 'OWNER'

SELECT a.accn_id
FROM acct AS a
JOIN dsp AS d ON d.ref2 = a.accn_id
JOIN dstr AS ds ON a.ref1 = ds.dstr_id
WHERE ds.a3 = 'Prague'
ORDER BY a.dt ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(c.gndr = 'M') / COUNT(c.clnt_id) AS percentage
FROM clnt c
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM dsp d
    JOIN acct a ON d.ref2 = a.accn_id
    WHERE d.ref1 = c.clnt_id
      AND a.ref1 = (
          SELECT dstr_id
          FROM dstr
          WHERE a3 = 'south Bohemia'
          ORDER BY a4 DESC
          LIMIT 1
      )
)

SELECT ((MAX(CASE WHEN t.dt = '1998-12-27' THEN t.blnc END) - MAX(CASE WHEN t.dt = '1993-03-22' THEN t.blnc END)) / MAX(CASE WHEN t.dt = '1993-03-22' THEN t.blnc END)) * 100 AS increase_rate
FROM trns t
WHERE t.ref1 = (
    SELECT ln.ref1
    FROM ln
    ORDER BY ln.dt ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
AND t.dt IN ('1993-03-22', '1998-12-27')
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN stts = 'A' THEN amnt ELSE 0 END) * 100 / SUM(amnt) FROM ln
SELECT SUM(stts = 'C') * 100 / COUNT(ref1) AS percentage FROM ln WHERE amnt < 100000
SELECT acct.accn_id, dstr.a2, dstr.a3 FROM acct JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id WHERE YEAR(acct.dt) = 1993 AND acct.frqn = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

SELECT clnt.clnt_id, acct.accn_id, acct.frqn
FROM clnt
JOIN dsp ON clnt.clnt_id = dsp.ref1
JOIN acct ON dsp.ref2 = acct.accn_id
JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id
WHERE dsp.typ = 'OWNER'
  AND dstr.a3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND acct.dt BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2000-12-31'

SELECT acct.accn_id, acct.dt
FROM acct
JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id
WHERE dstr.a2 = 'Prachatice'
SELECT dstr.a2, dstr.a3 FROM ln JOIN acct ON ln.ref1 = acct.accn_id JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id WHERE ln.ln_id = 4990

SELECT acct.accn_id, dstr.a2, dstr.a3
FROM ln
JOIN acct ON ln.ref1 = acct.accn_id
JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id
WHERE ln.amnt > 300000

SELECT ln.ln_id, dstr.a2, dstr.a11
FROM ln
JOIN acct ON ln.ref1 = acct.accn_id
JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id
WHERE ln.drtn = 60

SELECT (dstr.a13 - dstr.a12) * 100 / dstr.a12
FROM ln
JOIN acct ON ln.ref1 = acct.accn_id
JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id
WHERE ln.stts = 'D'
SELECT CAST(SUM(dstr.a2 = 'Decin') AS DOUBLE) * 100 / COUNT(acct.accn_id) FROM acct JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id WHERE YEAR(acct.dt) = 1993
SELECT accn_id FROM acct WHERE frqn = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'

SELECT d.a2, COUNT(c.clnt_id) AS female_account_holders
FROM clnt c
JOIN dstr d ON c.ref1 = d.dstr_id
WHERE c.gndr = 'F'
GROUP BY d.a2
ORDER BY female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9

SELECT d.a2, COUNT(t.trns_id)
FROM trns t
JOIN acct a ON t.ref1 = a.accn_id
JOIN dstr d ON a.ref1 = d.dstr_id
WHERE t.typ = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.dt LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY d.a2
ORDER BY COUNT(t.trns_id) DESC
LIMIT 10
SELECT COUNT(dsp.ref2) FROM clnt JOIN dstr ON clnt.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id JOIN dsp ON dsp.ref1 = clnt.clnt_id WHERE dstr.a3 = 'south Bohemia' AND dsp.typ <> 'OWNER'

SELECT d.a3
FROM ln l
JOIN acct a ON l.ref1 = a.accn_id
JOIN dstr d ON a.ref1 = d.dstr_id
WHERE l.stts IN ('C','D')
GROUP BY d.a3
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(ln.amnt) FROM ln JOIN acct ON ln.ref1 = acct.accn_id JOIN dsp ON dsp.ref2 = acct.accn_id JOIN clnt ON dsp.ref1 = clnt.clnt_id WHERE clnt.gndr = 'M'
SELECT dstr_id, a2 FROM dstr WHERE a13 = (SELECT MAX(a13) FROM dstr)
SELECT COUNT(acct.accn_id) AS account_count FROM acct WHERE acct.ref1 = (SELECT dstr.dstr_id FROM dstr ORDER BY dstr.a16 DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM acct WHERE frqn = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trns WHERE trns.ref1 = acct.accn_id AND trns.oprt = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND trns.blnc < 0)
SELECT COUNT(ln.ln_id) FROM ln JOIN acct ON ln.ref1 = acct.accn_id WHERE acct.frqn = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND ln.dt BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' AND ln.amnt >= 250000
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM acct JOIN ln ON ln.ref1 = acct.accn_id WHERE acct.ref1 = 1 AND ln.stts IN ('C','D')
SELECT COUNT(clnt_id) FROM clnt WHERE gndr = 'M' AND ref1 = (SELECT dstr_id FROM dstr ORDER BY a15 DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1)
SELECT COUNT(crd.crd_id) FROM crd JOIN dsp ON crd.ref1 = dsp.dsp_id WHERE crd.typ = 'gold' AND dsp.typ = 'OWNER'
SELECT COUNT(acct.accn_id) FROM acct JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id WHERE dstr.a2 = 'Pisek'

SELECT DISTINCT d.a2
FROM trns t
JOIN acct a ON t.ref1 = a.accn_id
JOIN dstr d ON a.ref1 = d.dstr_id
WHERE YEAR(t.dt) = 1997 AND t.amnt > 10000

SELECT DISTINCT a.accn_id
FROM ord o
JOIN acct a ON o.ref1 = a.accn_id
JOIN dstr d ON a.ref1 = d.dstr_id
WHERE o.k_symb = 'SIPO'
  AND d.a2 = 'Pisek'

SELECT DISTINCT acct.accn_id
FROM acct
JOIN dsp ON acct.accn_id = dsp.ref2
JOIN crd ON crd.ref1 = dsp.dsp_id
WHERE crd.typ = 'gold'

SELECT MONTH(dt) AS month, AVG(amnt) AS average_amount
FROM trns
WHERE oprt = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND YEAR(dt) = 2021
GROUP BY MONTH(dt)
ORDER BY MONTH(dt)

SELECT DISTINCT t.ref1
FROM trns t
WHERE t.oprt = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND YEAR(t.dt) = 1998
  AND t.amnt < (
    SELECT AVG(t2.amnt)
    FROM trns t2
    WHERE YEAR(t2.dt) = 1998
  )

SELECT DISTINCT clnt.clnt_id
FROM clnt
JOIN dsp ON clnt.clnt_id = dsp.ref1
JOIN crd ON dsp.dsp_id = crd.ref1
JOIN acct ON dsp.ref2 = acct.accn_id
JOIN ln ON acct.accn_id = ln.ref1
WHERE clnt.gndr = 'F'

SELECT COUNT(acct.accn_id)
FROM clnt
JOIN dsp ON dsp.ref1 = clnt.clnt_id
JOIN acct ON dsp.ref2 = acct.accn_id
JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id
WHERE clnt.gndr = 'F' AND dstr.a3 = 'south Bohemia'
SELECT DISTINCT acct.accn_id FROM acct JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id JOIN dsp ON dsp.ref2 = acct.accn_id WHERE dstr.a2 = 'Tabor' AND dsp.typ = 'OWNER'

SELECT dsp.typ
FROM dsp
JOIN acct ON dsp.ref2 = acct.accn_id
JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id
WHERE dsp.typ <> 'OWNER'
AND dstr.a11 BETWEEN 8000 AND 9000

SELECT COUNT(a.accn_id)
FROM acct a
JOIN dstr d ON a.ref1 = d.dstr_id
WHERE d.a3 = 'north Bohemia'
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM trns t
    WHERE t.ref1 = a.accn_id
      AND t.bnk = 'AB'
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.a2 FROM dstr d JOIN acct a ON d.dstr_id = a.ref1 JOIN trns t ON a.accn_id = t.ref1 WHERE t.typ = 'VYDAJ'
SELECT AVG(a15) FROM dstr WHERE a15 > 4000 AND dstr_id IN (SELECT ref1 FROM acct WHERE dt >= '1997-01-01')
SELECT COUNT(crd.crd_id) FROM crd JOIN dsp ON crd.ref1 = dsp.dsp_id WHERE crd.typ = 'classic' AND dsp.typ = 'OWNER'
SELECT COUNT(clnt.clnt_id) FROM clnt JOIN dstr ON clnt.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id WHERE clnt.gndr = 'M' AND dstr.a2 = 'Hl.m. Praha'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN typ = 'gold' AND issd < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / COUNT(crd_id) FROM crd

SELECT clnt.clnt_id
FROM ln
JOIN dsp ON dsp.ref2 = ln.ref1
JOIN clnt ON clnt.clnt_id = dsp.ref1
WHERE dsp.typ = 'OWNER'
ORDER BY ln.amnt DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT dstr.a15 FROM acct JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id WHERE acct.accn_id = 532
SELECT dstr.dstr_id FROM ord JOIN acct ON ord.ref1 = acct.accn_id JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id WHERE ord.ordr_id = 33333
SELECT trns.amnt FROM trns JOIN dsp ON trns.ref1 = dsp.ref2 WHERE dsp.ref1 = 3356 AND trns.oprt = 'VYBER'
SELECT COUNT(acct.accn_id) FROM acct JOIN ln ON acct.accn_id = ln.ref1 WHERE acct.frqn = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' AND ln.amnt < 200000
SELECT crd.typ FROM crd JOIN dsp ON crd.ref1 = dsp.dsp_id WHERE dsp.ref1 = 13539
SELECT dstr.a3 FROM clnt JOIN dstr ON clnt.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id WHERE clnt.clnt_id = 3541

SELECT dstr.a2
FROM ln
JOIN acct ON ln.ref1 = acct.accn_id
JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id
WHERE ln.stts = 'A'
GROUP BY dstr.a2
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT clnt.clnt_id FROM clnt JOIN dsp ON clnt.clnt_id = dsp.ref1 JOIN ord ON dsp.ref2 = ord.ref1 WHERE ord.ordr_id = 32423

SELECT t.trns_id, t.ref1, t.dt, t.typ, t.oprt, t.amnt, t.blnc, t.k_symb, t.bnk, t.accn
FROM trns t
JOIN acct a ON t.ref1 = a.accn_id
WHERE a.ref1 = 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM acct JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id WHERE dstr.a2 = 'Jesenik'

SELECT DISTINCT clnt.clnt_id
FROM crd
JOIN dsp ON crd.ref1 = dsp.dsp_id
JOIN clnt ON dsp.ref1 = clnt.clnt_id
WHERE crd.typ = 'junior'
  AND crd.issd >= '1997-01-01'

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gndr = 'F' THEN c.clnt_id END) AS DOUBLE) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.clnt_id)
FROM clnt c
JOIN dsp d ON d.ref1 = c.clnt_id
JOIN acct a ON a.accn_id = d.ref2
JOIN dstr ds ON ds.dstr_id = a.ref1
WHERE ds.a11 > 10000

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ln.dt) = 1997 THEN ln.amnt ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ln.dt) = 1996 THEN ln.amnt ELSE 0 END)) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ln.dt) = 1996 THEN ln.amnt ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM ln
JOIN acct ON ln.ref1 = acct.accn_id
JOIN dsp ON dsp.ref2 = acct.accn_id
JOIN clnt ON dsp.ref1 = clnt.clnt_id
WHERE clnt.gndr = 'M'
  AND dsp.typ = 'OWNER'
  AND YEAR(ln.dt) IN (1996, 1997)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trns WHERE oprt = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND YEAR(dt) > 1995
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a3 = 'east Bohemia' THEN a16 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN a3 = 'north Bohemia' THEN a16 ELSE 0 END) FROM dstr
SELECT SUM(typ = 'OWNER') AS owner_count, SUM(typ = 'DISPONENT') AS disponent_count FROM dsp WHERE ref2 BETWEEN 1 AND 10

SELECT a.frqn, o.k_symb
FROM acct AS a
JOIN ord AS o ON a.accn_id = o.ref1
WHERE a.accn_id = 3 AND o.amnt = 3539
SELECT YEAR(c.brth_dt) FROM acct a JOIN dsp d ON a.accn_id = d.ref2 JOIN clnt c ON c.clnt_id = d.ref1 WHERE a.accn_id = 130 AND d.typ = 'OWNER'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT acct.accn_id)
FROM acct
JOIN dsp ON dsp.ref2 = acct.accn_id
WHERE dsp.typ = 'OWNER'
  AND acct.frqn = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

SELECT ln.amnt, ln.stts
FROM clnt
JOIN dsp ON clnt.clnt_id = dsp.ref1
JOIN acct ON dsp.ref2 = acct.accn_id
JOIN ln ON acct.accn_id = ln.ref1
WHERE clnt.clnt_id = 992

SELECT t.blnc, c.gndr
FROM trns t
JOIN dsp dcl ON dcl.ref2 = t.ref1 AND dcl.ref1 = 4
JOIN dsp down ON down.ref2 = t.ref1 AND down.typ = 'OWNER'
JOIN clnt c ON c.clnt_id = down.ref1
WHERE t.trns_id = 851
SELECT DISTINCT crd.typ FROM clnt JOIN dsp ON dsp.ref1 = clnt.clnt_id JOIN crd ON crd.ref1 = dsp.dsp_id WHERE clnt.clnt_id = 9
SELECT SUM(trns.amnt) FROM trns WHERE YEAR(trns.dt) = 1998 AND trns.ref1 IN (SELECT dsp.ref2 FROM dsp WHERE dsp.ref1 = 617)

SELECT DISTINCT clnt.clnt_id, acct.accn_id
FROM clnt
JOIN dsp ON clnt.clnt_id = dsp.ref1
JOIN acct ON dsp.ref2 = acct.accn_id
JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id
WHERE clnt.brth_dt BETWEEN '1983-01-01' AND '1987-12-31'
AND dstr.a3 = 'east Bohemia'

SELECT clnt.clnt_id
FROM clnt
JOIN dsp ON clnt.clnt_id = dsp.ref1
JOIN acct ON dsp.ref2 = acct.accn_id
JOIN ln ON acct.accn_id = ln.ref1
WHERE clnt.gndr = 'F'
GROUP BY clnt.clnt_id
ORDER BY MAX(ln.amnt) DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM clnt c
WHERE c.gndr = 'M'
  AND c.brth_dt >= '1974-01-01'
  AND c.brth_dt < '1977-01-01'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM dsp d
    JOIN trns t ON t.ref1 = d.ref2
    WHERE d.ref1 = c.clnt_id
      AND t.k_symb = 'SIPO'
      AND t.amnt > 4000
  )
SELECT COUNT(acct.accn_id) FROM acct JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id WHERE dstr.a2 = 'Beroun' AND acct.dt > '1996-12-31'
SELECT COUNT(c.clnt_id) FROM clnt c JOIN dsp d ON c.clnt_id = d.ref1 JOIN crd k ON d.dsp_id = k.ref1 WHERE c.gndr = 'F' AND k.typ = 'junior'

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN clnt.gndr = 'F' THEN clnt.clnt_id END) AS DOUBLE) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT clnt.clnt_id)
FROM clnt
JOIN dsp ON clnt.clnt_id = dsp.ref1
JOIN acct ON dsp.ref2 = acct.accn_id
JOIN dstr ON acct.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id
WHERE dstr.a3 = 'Prague'

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gndr = 'M' THEN c.clnt_id END) AS DOUBLE) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.clnt_id)
FROM clnt c
JOIN dsp d ON c.clnt_id = d.ref1
JOIN acct a ON d.ref2 = a.accn_id
WHERE a.frqn = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
SELECT COUNT(dsp.ref1) FROM dsp JOIN acct ON dsp.ref2 = acct.accn_id WHERE dsp.typ = 'OWNER' AND acct.frqn = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'

SELECT DISTINCT a.accn_id
FROM acct AS a
JOIN ln AS l ON l.ref1 = a.accn_id
WHERE l.drtn > 24
  AND a.dt < '1997-01-01'
  AND l.amnt = (
    SELECT MIN(l2.amnt)
    FROM ln AS l2
    JOIN acct AS a2 ON l2.ref1 = a2.accn_id
    WHERE l2.drtn > 24
      AND a2.dt < '1997-01-01'
  )

SELECT acct.accn_id
FROM clnt
JOIN dstr ON clnt.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id
JOIN dsp ON dsp.ref1 = clnt.clnt_id
JOIN acct ON acct.accn_id = dsp.ref2
WHERE clnt.gndr = 'F'
ORDER BY clnt.brth_dt ASC, dstr.a11 ASC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(clnt.clnt_id) FROM clnt JOIN dstr ON clnt.ref1 = dstr.dstr_id WHERE YEAR(clnt.brth_dt) = 1920 AND dstr.a3 = 'east Bohemia'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ln JOIN acct ON ln.ref1 = acct.accn_id WHERE ln.drtn = 24 AND acct.frqn = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' AND ln.stts = 'A'
SELECT AVG(ln.amnt) FROM ln JOIN acct ON ln.ref1 = acct.accn_id WHERE ln.stts IN ('C','D') AND acct.frqn = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

SELECT DISTINCT c.clnt_id, d.a2
FROM clnt c
JOIN dsp p ON c.clnt_id = p.ref1
JOIN dstr d ON c.ref1 = d.dstr_id
WHERE p.typ = 'OWNER'

SELECT DISTINCT clnt.clnt_id, YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(clnt.brth_dt) AS age
FROM clnt
JOIN dsp ON clnt.clnt_id = dsp.ref1
JOIN crd ON dsp.dsp_id = crd.ref1
WHERE crd.typ = 'gold' AND dsp.typ = 'OWNER'
